dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run's real array y, indexed by Fin q and Fin b.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real u and natural m, it is gamma_m(u) = (m as a real) * u / (1 - (m as a real) * u).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for a run. It requires n,b,q>0 and n=q*b; q-by-b arrays x and y; nonnegative uBar,uFma,uOut with uBar<=uFma; q*U(uBar,uFma,uOut)<1 and n*uBar<1; an order tag; and state and error data. It requires state(0)=0 and, for each k in Fin q, state(k+1) = (state(k)*(1+carryTheta(k)) + sum_j x(k,j)*y(k,j)*(1+termTheta(k,j)))*(1+delta(k)). It bounds |delta(k)| by U, |carryTheta(k)| by gamma_b(uBar), and |termTheta(k,j)| by gamma_b(uBar) when k=0 and gamma_(b+1)(uBar) otherwise. If order=LocalDef002 it additionally bounds |carryTheta(k)| by gamma_1(uBar). It also supplies q-by-b-by-n inner path errors bounded by uBar whose product of one-plus-error factors equals (1+termTheta(k,j)) times the later-carry product, and, conditionally when order=LocalDef002, analogous q-by-b-by-(q+b-1) path errors bounded by uBar with the same product identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All of these requirements are bundled into the universally quantified run. The target directly projects x, y, uBar, uFma, uOut, order, and state(q); the remaining bundled recurrence and path assumptions restrict which computed values can occur and support the asserted witnesses and bounds.

binders: n, b, and q are universally quantified natural numbers.
run is universally quantified over LocalDef003 n b q, so it is a bundled valid run with q-by-b real arrays x and y, real parameters uBar, uFma, and uOut, an order tag, and an accumulated real state.
alpha and beta are existentially quantified functions Fin q -> Fin b -> Real. Both may depend on n, b, q, and run; beta is quantified after alpha. The same witnesses must satisfy every conclusion.
Every componentwise assertion is universally quantified over k in Fin q and j in Fin b.
hypotheses: All hypotheses are bundled into run rather than written as separate implications.
The bundled dimensions satisfy n>0, b>0, q>0, and n=q*b.
Writing U for the effective parameter, the bundled smallness assumptions are q*U<1 and n*uBar<1.
The bundled state satisfies state(0)=0 and state(k+1) = (state(k)*(1+carryTheta(k)) + sum_j x(k,j)*y(k,j)*(1+termTheta(k,j)))*(1+delta(k)) for every k<q.
The bundled local factors satisfy |delta(k)|<=U, |carryTheta(k)|<=gamma_b(uBar), and |termTheta(k,j)|<=gamma_b(uBar) for k=0 and <=gamma_(b+1)(uBar) otherwise.
If the order tag is LocalDef002, the bundled carry factors additionally satisfy |carryTheta(k)|<=gamma_1(uBar).

The run includes inner path errors indexed by Fin q, Fin b, and Fin n, each bounded in absolute value by uBar, with their one-plus-error product equal to (1+termTheta(k,j)) times the product of later carry factors.

If the order tag is LocalDef002, the run also includes right-to-left path errors indexed by Fin q, Fin b, and Fin(q+b-1), each bounded in absolute value by uBar and satisfying the same product identity.
conclusions: There exist q-by-b real arrays alpha and beta such that computed = sum over k<q and j<b of x(k,j)*y(k,j)*(1+alpha(k,j))*(1+beta(k,j)).
For every k<q and j<b, |alpha(k,j)| <= gamma_q(U).
For every k<q and j<b, |beta(k,j)| <= gamma_n(uBar).
The unconditional forward error satisfies |S-computed| <= C(q,n)*A, where C(q,n)=gamma_q(U)+gamma_n(uBar)+gamma_q(U)*gamma_n(uBar).
If order=LocalDef002, then simultaneously |beta(k,j)| <= gamma_(q+b-1)(uBar) for every k,j and |S-computed| <= C(q,q+b-1)*A.
If uOut<=uFma and uBar=uFma, then simultaneously alpha(k,j)=0 for every k,j and |S-computed| <= gamma_n(uBar)*A.
mathematical_definitions: The index sets are Fin q = {0,...,q-1} and Fin b = {0,...,b-1}.
gamma_m(u) = m*u/(1-m*u), with m interpreted as a real number.
U = uOut if uFma<uOut; U=0 if uFma is not less than uOut and uFma<=uBar; otherwise U=uFma.
S = sum over k<q and j<b of x(k,j)*y(k,j), the exact scalar double sum.
A = sum over k<q and j<b of |x(k,j)|*|y(k,j)|.
The natural expression q+b-1 uses truncated natural subtraction, but the bundled positivity of q and b makes it the ordinary integer q+b-1.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every bundled valid run with positive dimensions n=q*b, there are two arrays of relative perturbations alpha and beta such that the final accumulated value state(q) is exactly the double sum of x(k,j)y(k,j) after multiplying each term by (1+alpha(k,j))(1+beta(k,j)). Alpha is uniformly bounded by gamma_q of the effective parameter U, and beta is uniformly bounded by gamma_n(uBar). Consequently, the absolute difference between the exact double sum and the computed value is bounded by [gamma_q(U)+gamma_n(uBar)+gamma_q(U)gamma_n(uBar)] times the sum of |x(k,j)||y(k,j)|. For the distinguished order tag LocalDef002, the same beta witness and error satisfy sharper bounds using q+b-1 instead of n. If uOut<=uFma and uBar=uFma, the same alpha witness is identically zero and the error is bounded by gamma_n(uBar) times the absolute product sum.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem ranges over LocalDef003 runs, not arbitrary dimensions, arrays, parameters, or computed values. Invalid data for which no such run exists make the universal statement vacuous.
Although n, b, and q are syntactically quantified over all natural numbers, every inhabited bundled run has n,b,q>0 and n=q*b; hence the principal q-by-b index sets are nonempty.
The implication containing the q+b-1 bounds is vacuous whenever the order tag is not LocalDef002.
The implication forcing alpha=0 and the simpler error bound is vacuous unless both uOut<=uFma and uBar=uFma hold.
The constructor explicitly guarantees q*U<1 and n*uBar<1. It does not separately store (q+b-1)*uBar<1, but that inequality follows from positivity, n=q*b, q+b-1<=q*b, and uBar>=0.

Real division in Lean is total even at a zero denominator. The bundled smallness conditions nevertheless make the denominators of the gamma quantities used in the principal bounds positive; the specialized denominator is positive by the preceding derived inequality.
When uFma is not less than uOut and uFma<=uBar, U is exactly zero. Given the bundled uBar<=uFma, this branch can occur only when uBar=uFma.
The error scale A is a scalar sum of componentwise absolute products, not a separately defined vector or matrix norm.
The proposition asserts existence but not uniqueness or a method for computing alpha and beta.
No interpretation of the run as actual machine arithmetic is encoded beyond the explicit state recurrence, local error-factor bounds, path-product identities, and parameter conditions.
ambiguities: The dossier gives no domain-level names or interpretation for the constructors of LocalDef001. Therefore LocalDef002 can only be described as the distinguished order tag that activates the sharper bounds.
The parameters uBar, uFma, and uOut have exact algebraic roles but no independently supplied physical or algorithmic interpretation.
